description: How far an interchange moves the residual stream, layer by layer: layer 1's output at the last token swapped for the counterfactual's, then the residual stream read at layers 0, 2 and 4 ({'layers': [0, 2, 4]}, a pick list: one value with a layers axis labelled 0, 2, 4) at the prompt's last two tokens ({'index': '-2:'}), in the clean and the patched forward, and their cosine similarity over hidden_size, one number per layer, row and position. Layer 0 is before the write and the second-to-last token is before it in the sequence, so there the two values are the same to the bit and their cosine is 1 to within rounding; the last token at layers 2 and 4 is where the patch shows.
